responsibility: Declares the ISO mathematical function interface for SHORTREAL values, including constants, elementary transcendental and trigonometric functions, power and rounding operations, and the module-specific exception-state query. It is the short-precision real-math specification parallel to RealMath and LongMath, exposing the public API used by gm2 programs for SHORTREAL computations.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public SHORTREAL math specification, declaring constants and function signatures only, while the companion ShortMath.mod provides the actual builtin/libm bindings.
